data.descriptionPlain:
About Hevo Data

Hevo is a no-code Data Pipeline platform trusted by 1,000+ companies globally, including Postman, Shopify, Doordash and Gartner. Backed by $42M from Peak XV Partners and Chiratae Ventures, we power the data infrastructure of companies that move fast.
 
We are consistently rated #1 on G2 in the ETL and Data Integration category (4.5+ rating) and are a Snowflake Premier Partner. Our product is in the market, loved by customers, and now entering its next growth phase.
 
With 600+ US customers already on the platform and a product that has matured significantly over the last two years, this is the ground-floor moment. Before the team scales, before the brand becomes obvious. The upside is real and uncapped.
 

Why This Role, Why Now
Own US mid-market and enterprise territory at a company with real product-market fit and 600+ reference customers already in the market.
Sell a product that CDOs, Heads of Data, and VP Analytics actually want to buy.
Inbound intent is high, and the G2 rating does your first slide for you.
Structured support: 50% of your pipeline comes via BDR coverage and inbound. The other 50% is yours to build, with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, and Outplay in your hands.
Solutions Engineering alignment for complex PoCs. You will not be alone in the technical room.
10% commission on every outbound deal you close. No ceiling.
Three-month protected ramp: full variable payout in months 1–3 while you build pipeline and close your first logos.

lists.content:
Must-Haves
  • 4 - 7 years of B2B sales experience, with meaningful time in a quota-carrying, net-new business role.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistent quota achievement. Not just hitting numbers, but understanding why you hit them.
  • Strong outbound instincts: you know how to build pipeline from cold, not just work inbound.
  • Comfortable working US-aligned hours. Typical shift is 6 PM to 3 AM IST, with flexibility on demand.
  • Executive communication and negotiation skills. You should be comfortable running a room with a CDO.
  • This is fairly technical product  - comfortable with getting into deep ends about technology is critical.

    • Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience selling technical products: data, analytics, DevOps, infrastructure, or developer tools.
  • Existing familiarity with the India-to-US selling model.
  • Proficiency with HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or equivalent stack.
    •  
    Your Sales Environment
  • CRM: HubSpot
  • Sequencing: Outplay (India) / Trellus (US)
  • Prospecting: Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Conversation Intelligence: Fathom, Screen AI (homegrown coaching tool)
  • Communication: Zoom, CallHippo
  • AI: Claude / OpenAI, available on demand
    •

Uncapped Upside
  • Competitive base salary with an uncapped variable structure.
  • 10% commission on every outbound deal closed. No cap, no ceiling.
  • 3-month ramp period: 100% variable payout guaranteed while you build pipeline.
  • Equity: competitive for the right experience, with details discussed during the process.

    • Insurance (100% Company-Paid Premiums)
  • Medical: INR 5,00,000 floater cover for you and up to 5 dependents.
  • Accident & Life: 2x Annual Base Pay (minimum INR 10L, maximum INR 50L).

    • Leave & Life
  • Earned, Wellness, Menstrual, Wedding, and Bereavement leave, plus statutory Maternity (26 weeks) and Paternity (2 weeks).
  • Complimentary daily lunch, stocked pantries, on-site valet parking.
    •  
    Office & Commute
  • Cab reimbursements for late-night or US-shift hours.
    •  
    Growth & Wellness
  • Company-paid conferences and upskilling reimbursements for professional courses.
  • Wellness Benefit: INR 10,000/year for gym, yoga, or mental health.
    •  
    Family & Future
  • Partnered near-office creche support (70:30 co-pay).
  • Voluntary NPS setup and Gratuity benefits.

data.descriptionPlain:
About Hevo:

At Hevo, we are changing the way companies leverage data to drive user experience, growth, and business processes.  There has been a fundamental change in the amount of data companies are generating on a day-to-day basis. More and more users in an organization are now looking to use data to drive business decisions. Data is no longer a second-class citizen and companies are seeing data as a competitive advantage. We see this change and we are on a mission to change the way companies leverage their data. 

With a technology platform processing more than 100 billion records a month and doubling itself every 6 months, Hevo is poised for exponential growth in the coming future. This position provides a unique opportunity to create a massive impact on all existing and future customers of Hevo through technology innovation.

If you are the one who is looking to take a leap of faith and work on the technology of the future, if you obsess over customer satisfaction and experience then we are looking for you.

Role Summary

The AI Solutions Engineer will prototype, test, and deliver internal AI applications that improve efficiency across GTM teams (Marketing, Sales, BizOps). The role combines applied AI/ML knowledge, software engineering skills, and a strong understanding of GTM workflows to deliver practical, business-impacting solutions.

Role Summary

The AI Solutions Engineer will prototype, test, and deliver internal AI applications that improve efficiency across GTM teams (Marketing, Sales, BizOps). The role combines applied AI/ML knowledge, software engineering skills, and a strong understanding of GTM workflows to deliver practical, business-impacting solutions.

lists.content:
• AI Application Development
  • Build internal applications using LLMs and AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic).
  • Integrate AI into GTM tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, LinkedIn, Outreach, Google Sheets, etc.
  • Develop scripts and automations for data enrichment, copy assistance, and reporting.

  • Prototyping & Experimentation
  • Rapidly test new AI models and APIs, validate feasibility, and create MVPs.
  • Evaluate and document performance, accuracy, and usability for GTM use cases.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with Marketing, Sales, and BizOps teams to capture pain points and translate them into AI-driven solutions.
  • Provide demos, documentation, and training to internal users.

  • Operational Support
  • Maintain and optimize deployed tools.
  • Ensure compliance, data privacy, and reliability in AI-driven workflows.

• You’ve delivered 2–3 working AI prototypes that GTM teams actively use.
  • You’ve automated or optimized at least 2 GTM workflows, saving time and improving accuracy.
  • You’ve documented solutions in a way that makes them scalable and transferable.
  • You’ve demonstrated measurable impact on GTM productivity (hours saved, efficiency gains, improved decision-making).

• Knowledge & Skills:

  • Strong understanding of AI/ML fundamentals (NLP, LLMs, embeddings, prompt engineering).
  • Proficiency in Python and working with APIs (REST/GraphQL).
  • Experience with prototyping tools/frameworks (Flask, FastAPI, Streamlit, or similar).
  • Familiarity with GTM systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, or BI tools (Tableau, Looker).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to rapidly prototype creative solutions.
  • Upto 5 years of experience in building end-to-end applications

  • Abilities:

  • Translate messy GTM data into usable inputs for AI models.
  • Map AI outputs into real-world GTM workflows and processes.
  • Communicate technical solutions clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Balance speed of experimentation with reliability and compliance.

• Work on cutting-edge AI applications in a high-growth SaaS company.
  • Be part of the GTM innovation function, directly impacting Marketing, Sales, and BizOps productivity.
  • Gain exposure to real-world AI use cases that scale with thousands of customers.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and own end-to-end AI solutions from idea to deployment.

data.descriptionPlain:
About Hevo (HevoData.com)

Hevo is a simple, intuitive, and powerful No-code Data Pipeline platform that enables companies to consolidate data from multiple software for faster analytics. 
Hevo powers data analytics for 2000+ data-driven companies across multiple industry verticals including Deliverr, Neo4J, Groww, Marqeta, and Betway. By automating complex data integration tasks, Hevo allows data teams to focus on deriving groundbreaking insights and driving their businesses forward.
Hevo’s mission is simple, but bold: Build technology from India, for the world that is simple to adopt and easy to access so that everyone can unlock the potential of data.
Based in San Francisco and Bangalore, Hevo has seen exponential growth since its inception. The team has grown by 3X and the customer base has expanded by a staggering 20X in just the last two years. 
With a total funding of $42 Mil from Sequoia India, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, Hevo is now entering a new phase of hyper-growth. 
Hevoites are a bunch of thoughtful, helpful problem solvers, who are obsessed with making a difference in the lives of their customers, colleagues and their own individual trajectory. 
If you are someone who is passionate about redefining the future of technology, then Hevo is the place for you.

What You’ll own as Analytics Manager at Hevo

Define the Right Metrics to Track
Partner with the function heads across Product, Sales, Marketing, Support and Strategy to understand the key business drivers
Define the right KPIs and metrics to track across the organization. Build processes to make them readily and reliably available to everyone

Provide Meaningful Data-driven Insights to Drive Business Growth
Lead complex deep-dive into business metrics, identify bottlenecks and growth triggers. Make recommendations to the business heads on the next course of action
Work with the data analysts to build and maintain powerful dashboards that empower stakeholders to make data-informed decisions in real time

Build an A+ Analytics team
Nurture a team of highly skilled analysts by building strong frameworks for 1:1 coaching, performance management, and individual development plan
Create a hiring roadmap and own hiring targets to scale the analytics team as business needs grow

Refine Data Architecture and Data Practices
Strengthen the internal data architecture by working with data engineers to ensure comprehensive and reliable data is available for analysis
Optimize analytics processes to improve the effectiveness of reporting - make key data sets easily available, reduce rework, improve turn around time and quality of insights drawn
Set up a prioritization framework to balance competing analytics requests from different departments

lists.content:

  • Strong experience (and track record) of leveraging data and applying advanced analytics solutions to solve business problems
  • Strong understanding of modern data stack and experience in working with complex data systems and data visualization tools
  • Experience in driving operational improvement across data analytics practices

lists.text: Key elements needed to succeed in this role
lists.content:
• Excellent communication and articulation skills
  • Ability to think critically and navigate open-ended issues
  • Ability to synthesize large data sets and identify patterns
  • High problem-solving ability - should be able to diagnose a problem correctly using qualitative and quantitative methods
  • High business acumenHigh attention to detail

• 7-10 years of experience with demonstrated business impact
  • Work Experience - Should have experience in leading analytics teams in any of the following type of companies 
  • a) Large scale B2C setups in Ed-tech or consumer businesses like Swiggy / Zepto / Cure.fit / Byju’s / Simplilearn / Upgrad, etc. 
  • b) FinTech businesses Groww / UpStox / Paytm / BharatPe / PhonePe, etc. Engineering degree from IIT / NIT / BITS

lists.content:
This isn't a traditional associate sales role where you spend years qualifying leads before earning the chance to close.

We're building a team of Account Executives who will own business from day one. You'll sell into US-based SMB customers, run full sales cycles, and build the skills required to become a Mid-Market and Enterprise seller over time.

If you've been selling larger, more complex deals and want more velocity...
If you've been a top-performing BDR or SDR waiting for your opportunity to close...
Or if you've built your sales career in IT Services or custom software sales and want to break into product SaaS...

This is the opportunity.

At Hevo, Associate AEs are trusted with real revenue responsibility from the start.

You'll own an annual quota of $200K-$300K ARR, selling products typically below $8K ACV into the US market.

Unlike many organizations where SMB sales is treated as an entry point, we believe great SMB sellers become exceptional Mid-Market and Enterprise sellers. This role is designed to accelerate that journey.

What You Will Get

  • Own the complete sales cycle—from discovery to close—from your first few months.
  • Sell to founders, engineering leaders, analytics teams, and business decision-makers across the US.
  • High inbound demand supported by Hevo's #1 G2 ranking and strong product-market fit.
  • Structured pipeline support from Marketing and BDRs while also learning how to generate your own opportunities.
  • Dedicated Solutions Engineers available whenever technical conversations require deeper product expertise.
  • Three-month protected ramp with 100% variable payout while you build confidence and pipeline.
  • A clearly defined growth path into Mid-Market Account Executive roles based on performance - not tenure.

• Own a US SMB territory and manage a mix of inbound and outbound opportunities to drive new customer acquisition.
  • Run the full sales cycle from discovery and product demonstrations to negotiation and close.
  • Build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders by understanding their challenges and delivering value-driven solutions.
  • Maintain a healthy pipeline through disciplined prospecting, follow-ups, and effective territory management.
  • Partner with Solutions Engineers on technical evaluations and leverage modern SaaS sales methodologies to improve win rates.
  • Maintain accurate CRM hygiene, forecast effectively, and consistently work toward achieving an annual quota of $200K–$300K ARR.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally while continuously building your product knowledge and sales skills to grow into a Mid-Market Account Executive role.

Must Have

  • 2-5 years of quota-carrying B2B sales experience.
  • Experience selling into US or international markets is preferred.
  • Demonstrated history of consistently achieving or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong communication skills with confidence speaking to business and technical buyers.
  • Comfortable learning technical products and explaining business value.
  • Willingness to work US-aligned hours (typically 6 PM-3 AM IST, with flexibility as required).
  • Highly coachable, competitive, and eager to build a long-term SaaS sales career

lists.text: We'd Especially Love To Talk If You Have Experience In
lists.content:
• B2B SaaS sales, particularly Mid-Market or Enterprise environments.

  • Enterprise SDR/BDR roles with strong discovery, qualification, and pipeline generation experience.

  • IT Services, Cloud Services, Digital Engineering, or Custom Software sales with end-to-end ownership.

  • Selling technical products such as cloud, infrastructure, analytics, developer tools, or data platforms.

    • We care less about where you've worked and more about whether you've consistently delivered results, are hungry to learn, and want to build a career closing deals in B2B SaaS.

• CRM: HubSpot
  • Sequencing: Outplay (India) / Trellus (US)
  • Prospecting: Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Conversation Intelligence: Fathom, Screen AI (homegrown coaching tool)
  • Communication: Zoom, CallHippo
  • AI: Claude / OpenAI, available on demand

Uncapped Upside
  • Competitive base salary with an uncapped variable structure.
  • 10% commission on every outbound deal closed. No cap, no ceiling.
  • 3-month ramp period: 100% variable payout guaranteed while you build pipeline.
  • Equity: competitive for the right experience, with details discussed during the process.

About Hevo
Hevo Data is a no-code data pipeline platform that helps companies consolidate data from multiple sources for faster analytics. Our fully managed pipelines let data teams move data from 150+ sources (databases, SaaS applications, cloud storage, SDKs, streaming services) into warehouses and lakes, all without writing code.
Over 2,000 data teams in 45+ countries use Hevo, including DoorDash, Foot Locker, Arhaus, and Santander. We’re top-rated in the G2 Data Pipeline category, backed by Sequoia Capital, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, and operate out of San Francisco and Bangalore.
Role Summary
An Associate Customer Experience Engineer owns customer issues end-to-end, keeps unnecessary escalations to a minimum, and ensures every interaction reflects a high standard of customer experience.
This role centers on troubleshooting JDBC-based sources and integrations, partnering closely with Product and Engineering whenever an issue calls for deeper investigation. The role calls for building solid technical depth over time, following and refining support workflows, putting AI and automation to good use, and adding to the team's shared knowledge so issues get resolved faster and more consistently across the board.
Key Responsibilities
Own customer issues and drive them to resolution within SLA timelines, combining structured investigation with clear, timely updates to the customer.
Investigate issues by digging into SQL, logs, API responses, database behavior, product documentation, and other diagnostic tools available.
Loop in Product and Engineering as needed, sharing the relevant technical context, investigation findings, and steps to reproduce the issue.
Keep unnecessary escalations to a minimum by building strong product and technical knowledge and resolving issues independently wherever possible.
Follow established support processes and flag improvements that cut down on rework, manual effort, and resolution time.
Use AI-assisted tools, automation, and diagnostic capabilities to make troubleshooting faster and more consistent.
Build deeper technical expertise in JDBC-based sources and integrations, along with databases, APIs, ETL, and related technologies.
Add to SOPs, KB articles, onboarding material, and other knowledge assets the wider team relies on.
Support teammates when needed and take an active part in team training, enablement, and knowledge-sharing activities.
What Success Looks Like
Steady SLA adherence combined with consistently high-quality resolutions on owned tickets.
A growing ability to resolve technically complex issues without outside help.
An avoidable escalation rate that stays low and keeps trending downward.
Customer communication that is clear, accurate, and easy to act on.
Meaningful, ongoing contributions to SOPs, KBs, and broader team enablement.
Real, measurable use of AI and automation to cut down on manual effort and resolution time.
Visible growth in technical depth and troubleshooting capability over time.
Required Skills & Experience
Solid grasp of cloud technologies and core database concepts, including the basics of database administration.
Hands-on experience troubleshooting databases, applications, or integrations.
Strong command of SQL.
Familiarity with data warehousing, ETL, REST APIs, and webhooks.
Working knowledge of Java or another object-oriented programming language.
Sharp troubleshooting, debugging, research, and problem-solving abilities.
Background in technical product support, including email-based support.
Able to write and maintain clear technical documentation such as KBs and SOPs.
Strong written and verbal communication with a sharp eye for detail.
Genuinely curious and customer-first, with the ability to break down and synthesize technical information effectively.
Preferred Qualifications
1–3 years in technical product support, application support, database support, or a similar technical role.
Hands-on experience troubleshooting JDBC-based sources or integrations.
DBA experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or a similar database platform.
Background supporting B2B SaaS products or integration platforms.
Exposure to ETL/data integration platforms.

We’re looking for a strong leader to build and run the CS function. You’ll own the full post-sales journey (onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion) and be directly accountable for Net Revenue Retention and customer health across our global base.

A growing team of TAMs, based primarily in Bangalore and Pune
A product with 1000+ customers but an evolving post-sales playbook for 250-300 accounts
A customer base spanning SMB to enterprise across e-commerce, fintech, medtech and B2B Software companies.
Strong executive support and buy-in for investing in Technical Account Management
A chance to shape CS strategy at a company that’s defining the data pipeline category
Responsibilities
Build and Own the TAM Program
Design and roll out Hevo-specific TAM playbooks covering onboarding, adoption, health scoring, renewal, and expansion
Segment the customer base (enterprise, mid-market, self-serve) and build the right engagement model for each
Own net revenue retention, gross retention, and expansion metrics
Drive Customer Outcomes
Improve renewal rates and reduce churn by driving deeper product adoption and making sure customers see tangible results
Work with Sales on cross-sell and upsell opportunities, always leading with retention
Build customer advocacy through NPS programs, case studies, and community engagement
Grow lifetime value by catching risks early through health monitoring and having clear playbooks for when to step in
Customer Lifecycle
Map out the customer journey for Hevo’s technical buyers and end users
Set up the right checkpoints across the lifecycle (usage data, satisfaction signals, support sentiment) and create standard responses for each stage
Keep improving based on what the data and customer feedback tell you

Hire and develop strong TAMs
Put together an onboarding process that gets new hires productive fast
Build a team culture where people are technically curious, care about customers, and take ownership of outcomes

Define and track operational metrics: time-to-value, adoption rates, health scores, NRR, GRR.
Build dashboards and regular review cadences, and report key metrics to the executive team and board
Cross-Functional Work
Work with Product to make sure customer insights feed into the roadmap
Coordinate with Sales on ideal customer definition, handoff process, and expansion pipeline
Team up with Marketing on customer campaigns, advocacy programs, and lifecycle comms
Work with Finance on forecasting, renewal projections, and unit economics
Invest in CS/TAM Technology
Use AI and automation to make the program more efficient and scale the team’s impact without growing headcount at the same rate

Must-Have
10+ years of overall experience, and 5+ years leading Technical Customer Success or Tech Account Mgmt teams in B2B SaaS, with experience building or scaling a technical CS/TAM function
Experience with technical or developer-facing products, ideally in data infrastructure, analytics, or related areas like ETL/ELT, data warehousing, observability, or DevOps
Track record of owning and improving net revenue retention in a subscription / recurring-revenue business
Comfortable managing technical CSEs who spend their days working with data engineers and analysts
Analytical and numbers-driven. You make decisions based on data and you build the systems to track it
Strong communication skills. Comfortable presenting to the board and working across functions to get things done

Nice-to-Have
Time spent at a modern data stack company (Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks, Airbyte, or similar)
Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models
Mix of technical (engineering, solutions) and business (CS, account management) experience
Experience managing CSEs across multiple geographies or time zones

Why Hevo?

Drive Customer Outcomes
Improve renewal rates and reduce churn by driving deeper product adoption and making sure customers see tangible results
Work with Sales on cross-sell and upsell opportunities, always leading with retention
Build customer advocacy through NPS programs, case studies, and community engagement

10+ years of overall experience, and 5+ years leading Technical Customer Success or Tech Account Mgmt teams in B2B SaaS, with experience building or scaling a technical CS/TAM function

Time spent at a modern data stack company (Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks, Airbyte, or similar)

Experience managing CSEs across multiple geographies or time zones

What you’ll own as Associate SDE at Hevo:
 
. Implement SaaS connectors for assigned applications, learning application specific nuances like basic auth and data extraction.
. Assist in building simple REST API components, focusing on clean implementation and testing.
. Debug and optimize code for data pipeline efficiency under mentorship.
. Contribute to feature breakdown, coding, and documentation for smaller tasks.
. Apply logical thinking to solve integration issues and improve component quality.
.Build internal tools with AI for business teams to run their functions
 
What you’ll bring to the table:
 
. Basic object-oriented programming skills and familiarity with design principles.
. Exposure to data pipelines or APIs; eagerness to learn concurrency and performance basics.
. Foundational knowledge of REST APIs (e.g., making calls, handling JSON) – no deep expertise needed.
. Proficiency in Java/TypeScript/Python, good problem-solving with data structures and algorithms.
. Strong analytical and logical thinking for real-world challenges.
 
Candidate Persona:
 
. Freshers with experience in software development, ideally with internships in integrations or data tools.
. B Tech in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed college.

About Hevo:
Hevo is a no-code Data Pipeline platform trusted by 1,000+ companies globally, including Postman, Shopify, Doordash and Gartner. Backed by $42M from Peak XV Partners and Chiratae Ventures, we power the data infrastructure of companies that move fast.
We are consistently rated #1 on G2 in the ETL and Data Integration category (4.5+ rating) and are a Snowflake Premier Partner. Our product is in the market, loved by customers, and now entering its next growth phase.
With 600+ US customers already on the platform and a product that has matured significantly over the last two years, this is the ground-floor moment. Before the team scales, before the brand becomes obvious. The upside is real and uncapped.
About the Role:
We're looking for an Associate Technical Writer who's comfortable working in a docs-as-code environment and can partner with AI tools (e.g., Claude) for all aspects of the work — not just writing, but operating within an automated documentation pipeline.
This is an opportunity to own documentation end-to-end within a modern, AI-assisted workflow, working closely with engineering, product, and support stakeholders to keep a shared source of truth accurate and consistent.
What You'll Do:
Create and maintain user documentation using a docs-as-code workflow — Markdown/YAML source files, Git-based version control, and CI-driven publishing (e.g., Jekyll).
Independently own small documentation tickets and projects end-to-end, from research through PR merge.
Use AI-assisted tools (Claude or equivalent) to draft, summarize, restructure, or QA content, while critically reviewing and editing AI output rather than publishing it as-is.
Conduct research and gather technical information from product specs, engineering discussions, and existing docs to fill knowledge gaps.
Follow and help enforce documentation standards, style guides, and metadata conventions (e.g., structured fields for error messages, FHS-style rule sets) across a shared source of truth.
Work in Git-based workflows: branching, raising PRs, responding to review comments, and triggering automation for doc builds/publishing.
Collaborate with engineering, product, and support stakeholders to validate technical accuracy before publishing.
Flag ambiguous, unverified, or inferred content rather than publishing unconfirmed information.
What We're Looking For:
Strong written English and ability to simplify technical concepts for end users.
Basic familiarity with Markdown, Git (clone/branch/commit/PR), and a willingness to use docs-as-code tooling.
Comfort using AI writing/review tools as part of a daily workflow (prompting, verifying, editing output), including the ability to create and manage Claude skills.
Ability to read and interpret product UI, API docs, or basic YAML/JSON structures well enough to document them.
Detail-oriented, especially around consistency (terminology, tone, formatting) across a large, distributed content set.
0-2 years of experience in technical writing, content, or a related field; internships or academic writing experience acceptable.
Bonus Points:
Exposure to a ticketing/PM tool (Jira, Confluence) and Slack-based collaboration.
Intermediate AI skills creation.

We are consistently rated #1 on G2 in the ETL and Data Integration category (4.5+ rating) and are a Snowflake Premier Partner. Our product is in the market, loved by customers, and now entering its next growth phase.

With 600+ US customers already on the platform and a product that has matured significantly over the last two years, this is the ground-floor moment. Before the team scales, before the brand becomes obvious. The upside is real and uncapped.

About the Role:

We're looking for an Associate Technical Writer who's comfortable working in a docs-as-code environment and can partner with AI tools (e.g., Claude) for all aspects of the work — not just writing, but operating within an automated documentation pipeline.

This is an opportunity to own documentation end-to-end within a modern, AI-assisted workflow, working closely with engineering, product, and support stakeholders to keep a shared source of truth accurate and consistent.

What You'll Do:

  • Create and maintain user documentation using a docs-as-code workflow — Markdown/YAML source files, Git-based version control, and CI-driven publishing (e.g., Jekyll).

  • Independently own small documentation tickets and projects end-to-end, from research through PR merge.

  • Use AI-assisted tools (Claude or equivalent) to draft, summarize, restructure, or QA content, while critically reviewing and editing AI output rather than publishing it as-is.

  • Conduct research and gather technical information from product specs, engineering discussions, and existing docs to fill knowledge gaps.

  • Follow and help enforce documentation standards, style guides, and metadata conventions (e.g., structured fields for error messages, FHS-style rule sets) across a shared source of truth.

  • Work in Git-based workflows: branching, raising PRs, responding to review comments, and triggering automation for doc builds/publishing.

  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and support stakeholders to validate technical accuracy before publishing.

  • Flag ambiguous, unverified, or inferred content rather than publishing unconfirmed information.

What We're Looking For:

  • Strong written English and ability to simplify technical concepts for end users.

  • Basic familiarity with Markdown, Git (clone/branch/commit/PR), and a willingness to use docs-as-code tooling.

  • Comfort using AI writing/review tools as part of a daily workflow (prompting, verifying, editing output), including the ability to create and manage Claude skills.

  • Ability to read and interpret product UI, API docs, or basic YAML/JSON structures well enough to document them.

  • Detail-oriented, especially around consistency (terminology, tone, formatting) across a large, distributed content set.

  • 0-2 years of experience in technical writing, content, or a related field; internships or academic writing experience acceptable.

Bonus Points:

  • Exposure to a ticketing/PM tool (Jira, Confluence) and Slack-based collaboration.

  • Intermediate AI skills creation.

About Hevo: 
 
Hevo is a simple, intuitive, and powerful No-code Data Pipeline platform that enables companies to consolidate data from multiple software for faster analytics.
 
Hevo powers data analytics for 2000+ data-driven companies across multiple industry verticals including Deliverr, Neo4J, Groww, Marqeta, and Betway. By automating complex data integration tasks, Hevo allows data teams to focus on deriving groundbreaking insights and driving their businesses forward.

We’re looking for a self-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join Hevo’s Inside Sales team. This role is critical to building a strong outbound engine and directly contributing to pipeline and revenue growth.

lists.content:
Business Systems Engineers build internal tools and systems that help teams work better.

They work across functions such as Sales, Marketing, RevOps, Customer Success, Finance, and the Founders' Office. The role involves understanding a business problem, deciding the right technical approach, building the solution, and owning it after launch.

The solution could be custom software, an integration, an automation, a data workflow, or an AI-powered tool.

• Work with business teams to understand problems and identify opportunities for automation or better tooling.
  • Build and maintain internal applications, integrations, automations, and workflows.
  • Decide when to build custom software and when to use existing tools.
  • Use AI tools and APIs where they are useful for solving the problem.

• Strong problem-solving ability and good business context.
  • Ownership from problem definition through rollout and maintenance.
  • Ability to turn loosely defined problems into working solutions.
  • AI-native development: strong ability to use coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex to build significantly faster.

• Claude Code, Codex, or similar coding agents
  • Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar languages
  • SQL and databases
  • Git and standard development workflows
  • LLM APIs and agent frameworks
    • We care less about how much code someone can write manually and more about whether they can use AI effectively to build reliable software quickly.

lists.content:
Engineering Leadership & Strategy
● Define the long-term technical vision and engineering roadmap in alignment with Hevo’s product and business strategy.
● Build and scale engineering teams, fostering a high-performance culture rooted in ownership and innovation.
● Serve as a thought partner to the CXO, HoE and leadership team on product and platform evolution.

Architecture & Technical Direction
● Lead architectural decisions for a large-scale, real-time data platform ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability.
● Drive modernization across ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and metadata systems.
● Evaluate emerging technologies and adopt those that advance the platform’s capabilities and efficiency.
● Champion technical excellence and establish best practices across the org.

Delivery & Execution
● Oversee end-to-end product delivery, ensuring timely releases with high quality and customer impact.
● Build robust engineering processes (planning, reviews, incident management) to support rapid scaling.
● Partner closely with product management to align priorities and balance speed with long-term maintainability.
● Drive execution discipline while maintaining a bias for speed and innovation.

People & Organizational Development
● Attract, develop, and retain top engineering talent across multiple domains.
● Build leadership capacity within engineering through mentorship and succession planning.

AI-Native Engineering & Platform Intelligence
● Drive adoption of LLM-powered developer productivity tools to accelerate engineering throughput.
● Leverage AI to improve observability, incident triaging, and root cause analysis across distributed ingestion systems.
● Architect AI-assisted features for customers (e.g., automated connector mapping, transformation suggestions, query optimization).
● Establish responsible AI practices including governance, evaluation frameworks, and model performance monitoring.
● Identify opportunities to reduce operational overhead through automation and AI-driven decision systems.
● Embed AI/ML capabilities into the core platform (e.g., anomaly detection, pipeline health intelligence, intelligent retries, data quality insights).

Why Consider Leading the Engineering at Hevo
At Hevo, you will be leading the team working on one of the most technically challenging and impactful problems in modern data infrastructure: building a highly reliable, fault-tolerant data pipeline that powers decision-making for 2000+ enterprise companies across 40+ countries, including industry leaders like Shopify, DoorDash, Postman, and Zepto.

The Core Challenge
Companies today run on hundreds of business applications and databases. Each of these data sources evolves constantly. The structure of the data can change without warning, APIs behave unpredictably, and edge cases surface every day. Yet our customers rely on Hevo to unify all this data into their warehouses at internet scale.

Scale & Technology
The scale we operate at captures the magnitude of our engineering challenges
● 2000 companies across 40+ countries use Hevo.
● 150+ data sources with pre-built, battle-tested connectors
● 200GB/hour data transfer rate for each pipeline
● About 40k Pipelines
● 6 billion events processed per day
● 1PB+ data processed monthly
Our tech stack is built for this scale: AWS Fargate, Apache Kafka, RocksDB, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, InfluxDB, and Temporal, orchestrating multiple microservices across multi-tenant, auto-scaling infrastructure.

AI at the Core, Not Just the Surface
At Hevo, we build the infrastructure that makes AI possible in the first place. Without reliable, high-quality data, RAG breaks with stale or missing documents, agents hallucinate and take wrong actions, and copilots surface responses that can’t be trusted.
Beyond powering AI with clean, trustworthy data, we’re actively embedding AI directly into the heart of our core product. For example, one of our core initiatives is around building agents that behave like developers - autonomously creating, testing, and validating new data connectors.

Work with the Best Engineering Minds
You'll be working alongside engineers who've built systems at scale before at companies like Flipkart, Amazon, Linkedin, Microsoft, Oracle and Razorpay. These are smart, kind, and hardworking colleagues who bring deep expertise in distributed systems and are passionate about solving complex technical problems.

Why This Work Matters
Unlike much of the work in large organizations, the problems that engineering solves at Hevo are deeply technical and core to the company’s mission. Your work is not an add-on. It is the foundation. Every design decision directly impacts data reliability for some of the fastest-growing companies in the world.

Unique Advantage of Building at Hevo India
There are very few companies in India that build true data infrastructure products at this scale. In most global companies, the most complex and challenging engineering work happens outside India, while local teams handle peripheral or execution-heavy roles.
Hevo is different. Our entire engineering team is based in India. Every engineer works on the toughest problems, has full visibility into the product architecture, and contributes directly to the company's core technology. The learning and the impact are real and immediate.

Who Should Not Join Hevo
Hevo is not for everyone. We are solving deeply complex technical problems that demand rigor, creativity, and persistence. You may not be a fit if:
● You do not enjoy working on complex challenges or diving deep into the crux of a problem
● You are not passionate about building high-performance, high-quality, and scalable products used by thousands of large-scale customers
● You are looking for a settled role in a company that moves at a slow and steady pace. At Hevo, we move fast, but without breaking things

Join Us
We're at the perfect inflection point. We are at a scale where the technical challenges are massive but the team is still small enough that every engineer shapes the product's architecture and future.
The data infrastructure market is exploding. AI is creating unprecedented demand for reliable, real-time data. And we're building the foundational technology that will power the next generation of AI-native companies.

Qualification
● 15+ years of experience 
● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field required; Master’s degree preferred

About Hevo:
 
At Hevo, we are changing the way companies leverage data to drive user experience, growth, and business processes. There has been a fundamental change in the amount of data companies are generating on a day-to-day basis. More and more users in an organization are now looking to use data to drive business decisions. Data is no longer a second-class citizen and companies are seeing data as a competitive advantage. We see this change and we are on a mission to change the way companies leverage their data. 
 
With a technology platform processing more than 100 billion records a month and doubling itself every 6 months, Hevo is poised for exponential growth in the coming future. This position provides a unique opportunity to create a massive impact on all existing and future customers of Hevo through technology innovation.
 
If you are the one who is looking to take a leap of faith and work on the technology of the future, if you obsess over customer satisfaction and experience then we are looking for you.
 
About the Role:
 
We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the development of highly scalable, reliable, and secure platform services and database connectors that power mission-critical data pipelines for thousands of enterprise customers. These pipelines connect to modern data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks, as well as Data Lakes like Apache Iceberg.
 
This is a rare opportunity to own and build foundational systems, solve complex engineering challenges, and lead a high-impact team delivering best-in-class performance at scale.
 
You will play a central role in shaping our platform vision, driving high accountability, and fostering a culture of technical excellence and high performance—while working closely with cross-functional stakeholders across product, program, support, and business teams.

  • Drive technical leadership through architecture reviews, code guidance, and solving critical platform challenges.
  • Build and operate multi-tenant, distributed backend systems at scale.
  • Act as a technical leader—you’ve operated at least at Tech Lead, Staﬀ Engineer, or Principal Engineer level in your career.
  • Champion a culture of high accountability, clear ownership, and high visibility across engineering and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Collaborate deeply with Product, Program, Support, and Business functions to drive alignment and execution.
  • Embed principles of observability, reliability, security, and auditability into all aspects of the platform.

  • Strong experience with distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and multi-tenant platforms.
  • Proven ability to drive cross-team collaboration with product, support, business, and program teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive accountability, set clear goals, and raise the performance bar for the team.
  • Expertise in system design, scalability, performance optimization, and cost control.
  • Proven track record of mentoring engineers, guiding architecture, and leading impactful initiatives.
  • Clear communicator, adept at both strategy and execution.

• Experience with data engineering platforms, ETL systems, or database internals.
  • Exposure to product-driven companies, especially in infrastructure, SaaS, or backup/data systems.
  • Demonstrated history of fast-tracked growth or high-visibility impact.
  • Led or contributed to re-architecture or greenfield systems at scale.

lists.content:
• Lead, mentor and inspire a team of software engineers who take pride in ownership and delivering impact.
  • Ensure operational excellence through proactive monitoring, automated processes, and a culture of continuous improvement with strong accountability.
  • Drive a strong quality-first mindset, embedding it into the development lifecycle—from design to deployment.
  • Drive technical leadership through architecture reviews, code guidance, and solving critical platform challenges.
  • Build and operate multi-tenant, distributed backend systems at scale.
  • Act as a technical leader—you’ve operated at least at Tech Lead, Staﬀ Engineer, or Principal Engineer level in your career.
  • Champion a culture of high accountability, clear ownership, and high visibility across engineering and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Define and track data-driven KPIs to ensure operational eﬃciency, performance, and team eﬀectiveness.

  • Contribute to team growth, hiring, and building an inclusive, learning-focused engineering environment.

• 10+ years of experience in backend or systems software development.
  • 2+ years in a formal or informal Engineering Manager, Sr. Engineering Manager, or Tech Lead role in a fast-paced engineering environment.
  • Progression through senior IC roles like Tech Lead, Staﬀ, or Principal Engineer.
  • Strong experience with distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and multi-tenant platforms.
  • Proven ability to drive cross-team collaboration with product, support, business, and program teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive accountability, set clear goals, and raise the performance bar for the team.
  • Expertise in system design, scalability, performance optimization, and cost control.
  • Proven track record of mentoring engineers, guiding architecture, and leading impactful initiatives.
  • Clear communicator, adept at both strategy and execution.

• Experience with data engineering platforms, ETL systems, or database internals.
  • Exposure to product-driven companies, especially in infrastructure, SaaS, or backup/data systems.
  • Demonstrated history of fast-tracked growth or high-visibility impact.
  • Led or contributed to re-architecture or greenfield systems at scale.

data.descriptionPlain:
About Hevo
Hevo is a simple, no-code data pipeline platform that helps companies unify and prepare their data for analytics and AI. Hevo enables 2,500+ data-driven companies, including DoorDash, Shopify, and Postman, to get their data AI-ready by automating complex integration and transformation tasks across hundreds of sources.
 

 
About the Role
Every deal Hevo closes in the US starts somewhere: a webinar someone registered for, a booth conversation at a trade show, a case study that made a prospect say "we need this," a LinkedIn post from one of our execs that got shared around a buying committee. You'll be the person who makes all of that happen, reliably, every single week.
We already have the playbooks. Our webinar and field event programs are proven and consistently driving pipeline. We're ready to take these programs further, and we need someone to own that growth day-to-day. That's where you come in: own four high-impact programs end-to-end, ship consistently, and watch your fingerprints show up in the pipeline numbers every month.
What You'll Do
A. Webinar & Event Execution
Run monthly webinar promo cycles end-to-end (email, LinkedIn, partner, and BDR outreach) with accurate registration tracking and CRM campaign association.
Plan and execute in-person field events (trade shows, roundtables, meetups, partner events): build pre-event lists and outreach, schedule meetings, and manage all logistics and on-site ops.
Drive post-event follow-up sequences and ensure clean CRM uploads, so attendees convert into pipeline rather than just a headcount.
B. Customer Stories & Executive Thought Leadership
Schedule and run case-study interviews with Account Managers/TAMs and customers.
Draft the case study, hand off to Design, chase approvals to closure, and publish it out into the world.
Turn our execs' ideas and talking points into LinkedIn content that sounds like them: draft and repurpose thought-leadership posts and threads across multiple exec voices and accounts.
Own the posting cadence and keep the content pipeline consistently full.
C. Reporting
Track and report on registrations, attendance, content shipped, and pipeline/conversion impact across all four programs.
Use this data to flag capacity constraints or execution gaps back to your manager.
 

 
What You Bring
1-3 years of experience in field marketing, event marketing, or event management, ideally with some exposure to how events tie into pipeline/revenue, not just attendance.
Working knowledge of the event marketing lifecycle (pre/during/post), including sponsorships vs. field motion, booth ops, and dinners, and an understanding that follow-up is where pipeline is actually won.
Comfort orchestrating multi-channel promotion (email, LinkedIn, partner, BDR outreach) to fill a US-based event or webinar. Prior experience marketing to a US audience is a strong plus.
Strong copywriting and drafting skills: you can turn a rough brief into clean, on-message copy with minimal edits, and adapt to different voices (useful for the case study and thought-leadership work).
High execution rigour: you hit recurring deadlines without needing to be chased.
Assertiveness: you chase approvals, vendors, and internal stakeholders to closure on your own.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work independently as well as part of a cross-functional team, coordinating with AMs/TAMs, Design, BDRs, partners, and senior execs.
Why This Role?
You won't be one of ten people quietly maintaining a program. You'll personally own four of Hevo's sharpest pipeline-generating motions in the US market, with a direct line of sight from what you ship to what closes. If you're excited by fast execution, tight ownership, and watching your work move real numbers, this is that role.
This role is also built to grow. You'll start as the execution owner across all four programs, working off documented playbooks. As you build a track record, there's room to move into owning program strategy and targets directly, and beyond that, into a broader marketing programs/demand-gen ownership track.

About Hevo:
 
Hevo (www.hevodata.com) is a simple, intuitive, and powerful No-code Data Pipeline platform that enables companies to consolidate data from multiple software for faster analytics.
 
Hevo powers data analytics for 2000+ data-driven companies across multiple industry verticals, including Cult.fit, Postman, ThoughtSpot, Jawa Motorcycles. By automating complex data integration tasks, Hevo allows data teams to focus on deriving groundbreaking insights and driving their businesses forward.
 
Hevo’s mission is simple but bold: Build technology from India, for the world that is simple to adopt and easy to access so that everyone can unlock the potential of data.
 
Based in San Francisco and Bangalore, Hevo has seen exponential growth since its inception. With total funding of $42 million from Sequoia India, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, Hevo is now entering a new phase of hyper-growth.
 
Hevoites are a bunch of thoughtful, helpful problem solvers who are obsessed with making a difference in the lives of their customers, colleagues, and their own individual trajectory. If you are someone who is passionate about redefining the future of technology, then Hevo is the place for you.
 
About this Role:
 
Hevo is looking to hire a highly skilled finance professional to oversee accurate and timely monthly book closures, management reporting, and compliance with applicable accounting standards. This role requires strong accounting expertise, analytical acumen, and leadership skills to drive process improvements and ensure effective financial operations.

About this Role:

 

Hevo is looking to hire a highly skilled finance professional to oversee accurate and timely monthly book closures, management reporting, and compliance with applicable accounting standards. This role requires strong accounting expertise, analytical acumen, and leadership skills to drive process improvements and ensure effective financial operations.

lists.content:
Core Accounting Operations

  • Run day-to-day accounting for US Parent Entity.

  • Post journal vouchers, routine entries, and payment entries with high accuracy.

  • Maintain clean books with strong audit trails.

  • Flag anomalies early don’t just record, but review.


    • US Sales Tax Compliance (Good to have)

    • Ensure correct US sales tax application across state-wise invoices.

    • Reconcile tax data with Avalara and highlight gaps.

    • Support timely and accurate tax payments.

    • Drive closure of any mismatches proactively.

      • AR Hygiene & Collections Visibility

      • Publish the weekly overdue tracker for customer balances.

      • Partner closely with the AM team to drive collections follow-ups.

      • Monitor aging trends and flag risk accounts early.

        • Vendor Payments (AP Discipline)

        • Route vendor invoices for approvals across departments.

        • Review weekly vendor aging and payment readiness.

        • Prepare approved payment runs.

        • Maintain strong controls and documentation.

          • Billing Query Resolution

          • Act as the go-to POC for billing queries.

          • Work closely with the AM team to resolve customer issues quickly.

          • Track recurring themes and suggest process fixes.

          • Help improve overall customer billing experience.

            • Consolidation Support

            • Work with the India finance team post month-end.

            • Prepare consolidated financials for monthly closure.

            • Ensure inter-company alignment and data integrity.

              • Internal Audit Readiness

              • Support quarterly/half-yearly internal audits.

              • Provide audit evidence and walkthroughs for owned areas.

              • Help close audit observations in a timely manner.

                • Must have working familiarity with:

                • Stripe (good to have)

                • QuickBooks online

                • Zoho Books

                • Avalara (good to have)

• MBA / Chartered Accountants with 3 to 5 years of experience in finance roles, preferably with a SaaS setup.

  • In-depth knowledge of Accounting Standards - Gaap and IndAS, direct and indirect taxation. 

  • Experienced with any of the accounting ERP tools like Tally, Zoho, Quickbooks etc.

  • Excellent MS Office skills

  • Good communication skills

Hevo’s mission is simple but bold: Build technology from India, for the world that is simple to adopt and easy to access so that everyone can unlock the potential of data.

 

Based in San Francisco and Bangalore, Hevo has seen exponential growth since its inception. With total funding of $42 million from Sequoia India, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, Hevo is now entering a new phase of hyper-growth.

 

Hevoites are a bunch of thoughtful, helpful problem solvers who are obsessed with making a difference in the lives of their customers, colleagues, and their own individual trajectory. If you are someone who is passionate about redefining the future of technology, then Hevo is the place for you.

 

About this Role:

 

Hevo is looking to hire a highly skilled finance professional to oversee accurate and timely monthly book closures, management reporting, and compliance with applicable accounting standards. This role requires strong accounting expertise, analytical acumen, and leadership skills to drive process improvements and ensure effective financial operations.

data.descriptionPlain:
About Hevo
Hevo Data is a no-code data pipeline platform that helps companies consolidate data from multiple sources for faster analytics. Our fully managed pipelines let data teams move data from 150+ sources (databases, SaaS applications, cloud storage, SDKs, streaming services) into warehouses and lakes, all without writing code.
Over 2,000 data teams in 45+ countries use Hevo, including DoorDash, Foot Locker, Arhaus, and Santander. We're top-rated in the G2 Data Pipeline category, backed by Sequoia Capital, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, and operate out of San Francisco and Bangalore.
Why This Role Matters
Hevo's customers are data engineers, analytics leaders, and platform teams who run critical data infrastructure on us. When a pipeline breaks, their dashboards, reports, and downstream systems break with it. For our top accounts, every interaction with Hevo should feel white-glove: proactive, personal, and technically credible.
Premier Support at Hevo is not a ticket queue. It is a named, technical account management function that partners closely with our Account Management team to drive adoption, deepen usage, and protect renewals across our most valuable customers. Account Managers own the commercial relationship; you and your team own the technical relationship and the day-to-day customer experience that keeps these accounts healthy and growing.
We're looking for a hands-on leader who is equally at home in a customer business review, a Sev-1 war room, a weekly team operating review, and an API error log. We're a startup: you'll inherit a strong team and a solid foundation, not a finished playbook, and you'll be expected to build what's missing.
The Setup
A growing team of Technical Account Managers/Premier Support Engineers, based primarily in Bangalore and Pune
1,000+ customers, with a dedicated premier engagement model for our top 250–300 accounts that you will shape
A close partnership with Account Management: they own the commercial relationship, your team owns technical success, adoption, and the customer experience
A customer base spanning SMB to Enterprise across e-commerce, Fintech, Medtech, and B2B Software
Strong executive support and investment in white-glove, proactive customer engagement
A chance to define what premier support means at a company leading the data pipeline category

What This Role Is Built On
Four things matter most for success in this role, and we hire and evaluate against all four: customer management and communication, team management and operational diligence, technical strength in B2B cloud technologies, and high agency. The responsibilities below are organized around them.
Responsibilities
1. Customer Management and Communication
Own the technical relationship with premier accounts end to end: onboarding, adoption, stability, escalations, and renewal readiness
Deliver a white-glove experience for top customers: named coverage, proactive check-ins, regular business reviews, and a single accountable point of contact when things go wrong
Partner with Account Managers on joint account plans, QBRs, renewal risk reviews, and expansion opportunities, always leading with adoption and retention
Drive adoption: make sure customers are getting value from the pipelines, sources, and features they bought, and catch usage drops before they become churn risks
Personally lead high-severity and executive-level escalations, and run clear, timely incident communication and customer-facing RCAs
Build customer advocacy through NPS/CSAT programs, references, and case studies
2. Team Management and Operational Diligence
Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of TAMs and Premier Support Engineers, including future team leads
Design and run the operating model: account segmentation (Enterprise, Mid-market, Growth), coverage ratios, SLAs, severity levels, and escalation framework
Build playbooks for onboarding, proactive health monitoring, health scoring, escalation management, renewal readiness, and expansion
Define and track input and output metrics, and use them to run the team week to week:
Input: First Response Time, Time-to-Resolution, backlog and ticket aging, escalation rate, proactive touchpoints, business review coverage, pipeline health coverage
Output: CSAT, NPS, Time-to-Value, Adoption, Health Scores, NRR, GRR
Run a disciplined weekly cadence on at-risk accounts, open escalations, and team capacity, with clear owners and follow-through
Report key metrics and insights to the executive team
3. Technical Leadership
Be the most credible technical voice for premier customers: get hands-on with pipeline failures, API and integration issues, data latency, schema changes, and source/destination problems alongside your engineers
Diagnose issues across the B2B cloud stack: REST APIs, authentication (OAuth, API keys), rate limits, webhooks, networking, and cloud data warehouse
Be the voice of the premier customer to Product and Engineering, turning support and adoption trends into roadmap and reliability priorities
Raise the team's technical bar through enablement, runbooks, and knowledge sharing, so new hires become productive fast
Use AI, automation, and self-serve tooling to improve resolution speed and scale the team's impact without growing headcount at the same rate
4. High Agency and Building
Build the premier support function from where it is today: spot gaps, make decisions, and ship improvements without waiting for a finished blueprint
Roll up your sleeves when needed, whether that means taking a key account, jumping on a ticket, or building the first version of a dashboard yourself
Make calls with incomplete information, own the outcome, and adjust quickly
Drive change across Account Management, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Finance through data and influence rather than authority
Own the outcome metrics for the premier base: Gross Retention, Net Revenue Retention, and Adoption

Who We're Looking For
Must-Have
Experience: 12–18 years overall, with 5+ years leading Technical Account Management, Premier / Enterprise Support, Customer Success Engineering, or Support Engineering teams in B2B SaaS
Customer management and communication: a track record of owning relationships with enterprise customers, personally handling critical escalations, and turning at-risk accounts into advocates. Clear and crisp in writing and in the room, with both a customer's engineers and their C-level executives
Team management and operational diligence: has built and run a team on a clear operating rhythm of KPIs, SLAs, and reviews; understands how input metrics drive outcomes; has hired well and made hard people calls
Technical strength: hands-on depth in B2B cloud technologies: SaaS platforms, APIs and integrations, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), ideally with exposure to data systems (databases, warehouses, ETL/ELT). You can read logs, debug a failing API call or pipeline, and hold your own with a customer's engineers
High agency: clear evidence of building or rebuilding a function rather than just running an existing one, ideally in a startup or high-growth environment. You act without waiting for permission and own results end to end
Commercial awareness: understands how adoption and customer experience drive renewal and expansion, and has partnered with Account Management or Sales on retention outcomes

Nice-to-Have
Time spent at a modern data stack, integration, or cloud infrastructure company (Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks, Airbyte, Confluent, or similar)
Direct ownership of retention and expansion metrics (NRR, GRR) in a subscription or recurring-revenue business
Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing, and using usage data to drive adoption
Mix of technical (engineering, SRE, solutions) and business (support, CS, account management) experience
Experience managing teams across multiple geographies or time zones, especially supporting US customers from India
Experience introducing AI or automation into support or customer success operations

Why Hevo
We're in a large, growing market (data integration is projected to hit $17B+) and we're one of the leaders
Our customers actually like the product: top-rated on G2, with strong word-of-mouth growth
Sequoia Capital-backed with strong investor support
Premier support is treated as a growth and retention function here, not a cost center. You'll have real ownership and a seat at the table
Startup pace and scope: your decisions show up in customer outcomes within weeks, not quarters
Low-ego team with deep engineering and product roots

Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of TAMs and Premier Support Engineers, including future team leads
Design and run the operating model: account segmentation (Enterprise, Mid-market, Growth), coverage ratios, SLAs, severity levels, and escalation framework
Build playbooks for onboarding, proactive health monitoring, health scoring, escalation management, renewal readiness, and expansion
Define and track input and output metrics, and use them to run the team week to week:
Input: First Response Time, Time-to-Resolution, backlog and ticket aging, escalation rate, proactive touchpoints, business review coverage, pipeline health coverage
Output: CSAT, NPS, Time-to-Value, Adoption, Health Scores, NRR, GRR
Run a disciplined weekly cadence on at-risk accounts, open escalations, and team capacity, with clear owners and follow-through
Report key metrics and insights to the executive team
3. Technical Leadership
Be the most credible technical voice for premier customers: get hands-on with pipeline failures, API and integration issues, data latency, schema changes, and source/destination problems alongside your engineers
Diagnose issues across the B2B cloud stack: REST APIs, authentication (OAuth, API keys), rate limits, webhooks, networking, and cloud data warehouse
Be the voice of the premier customer to Product and Engineering, turning support and adoption trends into roadmap and reliability priorities
Raise the team's technical bar through enablement, runbooks, and knowledge sharing, so new hires become productive fast
Use AI, automation, and self-serve tooling to improve resolution speed and scale the team's impact without growing headcount at the same rate
4. High Agency and Building
Build the premier support function from where it is today: spot gaps, make decisions, and ship improvements without waiting for a finished blueprint
Roll up your sleeves when needed, whether that means taking a key account, jumping on a ticket, or building the first version of a dashboard yourself
Make calls with incomplete information, own the outcome, and adjust quickly
Drive change across Account Management, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Finance through data and influence rather than authority
Own the outcome metrics for the premier base: Gross Retention, Net Revenue Retention, and Adoption

Who We're Looking For
Must-Have
Experience: 12–18 years overall, with 5+ years leading Technical Account Management, Premier / Enterprise Support, Customer Success Engineering, or Support Engineering teams in B2B SaaS
Customer management and communication: a track record of owning relationships with enterprise customers, personally handling critical escalations, and turning at-risk accounts into advocates. Clear and crisp in writing and in the room, with both a customer's engineers and their C-level executives
Team management and operational diligence: has built and run a team on a clear operating rhythm of KPIs, SLAs, and reviews; understands how input metrics drive outcomes; has hired well and made hard people calls
Technical strength: hands-on depth in B2B cloud technologies: SaaS platforms, APIs and integrations, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), ideally with exposure to data systems (databases, warehouses, ETL/ELT). You can read logs, debug a failing API call or pipeline, and hold your own with a customer's engineers
High agency: clear evidence of building or rebuilding a function rather than just running an existing one, ideally in a startup or high-growth environment. You act without waiting for permission and own results end to end
Commercial awareness: understands how adoption and customer experience drive renewal and expansion, and has partnered with Account Management or Sales on retention outcomes

Nice-to-Have
Time spent at a modern data stack, integration, or cloud infrastructure company (Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks, Airbyte, Confluent, or similar)
Direct ownership of retention and expansion metrics (NRR, GRR) in a subscription or recurring-revenue business
Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing, and using usage data to drive adoption
Mix of technical (engineering, SRE, solutions) and business (support, CS, account management) experience
Experience managing teams across multiple geographies or time zones, especially supporting US customers from India
Experience introducing AI or automation into support or customer success operations

Why Hevo
We're in a large, growing market (data integration is projected to hit $17B+) and we're one of the leaders
Our customers actually like the product: top-rated on G2, with strong word-of-mouth growth
Sequoia Capital-backed with strong investor support
Premier support is treated as a growth and retention function here, not a cost center. You'll have real ownership and a seat at the table
Startup pace and scope: your decisions show up in customer outcomes within weeks, not quarters
Low-ego team with deep engineering and product roots

About Hevo

By removing engineering bottlenecks, Hevo allows teams to focus on what actually matters: generating insights, building intelligent products, and making faster decisions.
 
What You Will Own
You own how prospects find Hevo and what happens once they arrive. That spans the organic growth engine, the editorial voice, and AEO strategy that brings technical buyers to the site, plus the trial experience that turns a signup into a paying customer. The two halves are connected: the content you publish sets the intent of the person who signs up, and the trial experience decides whether that intent converts.
This role sits roughly 60% on inbound and organic growth, 40% on trial lifecycle and PLG conversion. You are not a reporter of traffic or a reporter of conversion rate. You are the person who defines what good looks like on both sides of the funnel, instruments it, and ships the work that moves it.
 
Core Responsibilities
1. Inbound, Editorial, and AEO (Primary)
Own Hevo's organic growth strategy and editorial voice across inbound, AEO, and content: find opportunities, plan, publish, track results, and improve performance
Manage the editorial calendar. Plan and prioritize website pages, blogs, guides, ebooks, and FAQs based on business goals
Set the quality standard for content and make sure everything published follows Hevo's messaging and tone
Work with writers, subject matter experts, freelancers, and agencies to get content created, edited, and published
Repurpose content across blogs, AI search engines, sales materials, and social media to extract more value from every piece
Optimize content to rank on Google and appear in AI search results. Own inbound and AEO, including schema, website structure, and making content accessible to search engines and AI crawlers
Build and maintain a backlink and digital PR strategy to strengthen domain authority
Run experiments on content performance, headlines, CTAs, and formats, and iterate based on conversion data rather than traffic alone
Set up and maintain dashboards (Looker Studio, GA4, GSC) that give a single view of content performance across the full funnel
 
2. Trial Lifecycle and Activation
Define what trial success looks like: set activation milestones, instrument the funnel, and report on conversion performance weekly
Map the trial journey from signup through first pipeline to the aha moment and conversion, and identify where intent drops
Design and run lifecycle communications: onboarding email sequences, in-app nudges, and re-engagement flows tied to behavioral triggers
Act as the internal voice of the trial user in product, GTM, and leadership conversations
3. Conversion Rate Optimization
Synthesize behavioral data (session recordings, funnel drop-off, in-app events) into structured conversion hypotheses with clear success metrics
Design and execute CRO across onboarding flows, high-intent landing pages, and trial touchpoints, with documented methodology and learnings
Partner with Design on landing page variants for use-case pages, competitor comparison pages, and ICP-segment pages. You define the hypothesis and copy, Design executes
Maintain a rigorous experiment log: hypothesis, variant rationale, statistical methodology, results, and learnings
4. Product and GTM Partnership
Surface structured, prioritized insights from organic visitors and trial users into the roadmap process weekly
Build technically credible collateral: setup walkthroughs, migration guides, and competitive comparison assets written for data practitioners, not buyers
Create and maintain a weekly product-to-GTM feedback brief synthesizing signals from content performance, trials, support tickets, and deal reviews
Support competitive displacement motions with content and push customers toward a switch decision

What You Need to Bring
Non-Negotiable
5–8 years across Inbound, or PLG at a B2B SaaS company, preferably selling to technical buyers, with direct ownership of organic performance or a self-serve conversion program and measurable outcomes
Strong writing and editing skills. Comfortable across thought leadership, technical content, and competitor comparison pages
Hands-on data background, or close enough experience alongside a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or Data Scientist to write for that audience without translation
Working understanding of PLG mechanics: activation frameworks, aha-moment design, in-product lifecycle marketing, and trial funnel instrumentation
Behavioral analytics skills: Amplitude, Mixpanel, or PostHog for funnel and activation tracking, plus Hotjar or FullStory for session analysis
Experimentation discipline across both content and product surfaces: A/B tests run with proper statistical methodology, not just a headline swap
Experience building dashboards or reports that connect content, SEO, and lifecycle metrics to pipeline and business outcomes

Strong Advantage
Experience improving visibility across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, and Gemini
Familiarity with ELT, data pipelines, or other technical products in a fast-growing startup environment
Familiarity with PLG tools: in-app messaging (Appcues, Pendo, or equivalent), lifecycle email (Customer.io, Braze), and interactive demos (Arcade, Navattic, Storylane)
Experience with competitive displacement content at the trial stage
Basic HTML/CSS comfort to push copy or CTA edits without filing a ticket
 
What Good Looks Like at 6 Months

Milestone
What It Looks Like
30 Days
Organic content audit and trial funnel audit both complete. Activation milestones defined. Editorial calendar live. First lifecycle experiment shipped.
90 Days
Organic traffic and AI visibility trending up against baseline. 5+ CRO or lifecycle experiments shipped with documented outcomes. Onboarding email sequence live and instrumented.
180 Days
Measurable improvement in organic pipeline contribution and trial-to-paid conversion. Competitive trial-stage and comparison content covering top displacement scenarios. Lifecycle and content experimentation embedded in sprint cycles.

Tools You Will Work With

Category
Tools
SEO / AEO
Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, AI visibility tracking tools
Web Analytics
GA4, Looker Studio
Product Analytics
Amplitude / Mixpanel / PostHog
Session Analysis
Hotjar / FullStory / Microsoft Clarity
Experimentation
VWO / Optimizely / Google Optimize
Lifecycle Marketing
Customer.io / Braze / equivalent
In-Product Messaging
Appcues / Pendo / equivalent
Demo & Interactives
Arcade / Navattic / Storylane 
This Role Is Not for You If
You have only done content marketing or demand gen and have never owned a self-serve conversion funnel with measurable outcomes
You need a separate analyst to tell you where the funnel is breaking before you can act
You have never written for a technical audience and are relying on learning it on the job
You treat content and lifecycle marketing as calendars to fill rather than systems that respond to data

data.descriptionPlain:
Product Manager - Hevo 

The Hard Thing About Data 
Most companies that claim to have a "data platform" have a dashboard with some charts and a dream. Hevo has something different. Something that took eight years to build and can't be bought. Over 2,000 companies send us their most sensitive data every single day. 100 billion events a month. Raw. Unfiltered. Before transformation, before aggregation, at the exact moment truth is created. That's not a product feature. That's trust, earned one customer at a time, over eight years, by not screwing up. 
That position is now the foundation for something much bigger. We're building an Intelligence Layer on top of it, a system that reads across every data source a company runs, connects the signals that matter, and tells people what to do before they have to go looking for answers. We call it the Context Graph. It's real enough to show results. Early enough that the person who joins now defines what it becomes. 
This is the moment. Not the moment after it's obvious. Now. 
What You're Walking Into 
You'll own a product pod. SaaS integrations, database connectors, or the Intelligence Layer, depending on where the biggest need is when you join. You own the backlog. data.descriptionPlain:
What you’ll own as SDE I at Hevo:
 
. Implement SaaS connectors for assigned applications, learning application specific nuances like basic auth and data extraction.
. Assist in building simple REST API components, focusing on clean implementation and testing.
. Debug and optimize code for data pipeline efficiency under mentorship.
. Contribute to feature breakdown, coding, and documentation for smaller tasks.
. Apply logical thinking to solve integration issues and improve component quality.
 
What you’ll bring to the table:
 
. Basic object-oriented programming skills and familiarity with design principles.
. Exposure to data pipelines or APIs; eagerness to learn concurrency and performance basics.
. Foundational knowledge of REST APIs (e.g., making calls, handling JSON) – no deep expertise needed.
. Proficiency in Java/TypeScript/Python, good problem-solving with data structures and algorithms.
. Strong analytical and logical thinking for real-world challenges.
 
Candidate Persona:
 
. 0-1 years in software development, ideally with internships in integrations or data tools.
. B Tech in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed college.
