ABOUT HEVO DATA
Hevo Data is a fully managed, no-code Automated Data Pipeline platform trusted by 2,000+ customers across 40+ countries - including Postman, Zepto, ThoughtSpot, Whatfix, Shopify, and DoorDash. Headquartered in San Francisco with a strong engineering presence in Bangalore, we are backed by Sequoia Capital, Chiratae, and Qualgro, having raised $43 Million to date.
Our mission is to enable every company to be data-driven. Hevo Pipeline offers 150+ integrations with databases, SaaS applications, advertising channels, streaming services, and cloud storage - making real-time data consolidation effortless for business and engineering teams alike.Every company wants to leverage AI, Machine Learning, and Predictive Analytics to make smarter decisions - but fragmented data across hundreds of business tools makes this nearly impossible. Data operators spend most of their time manually consolidating information, leaving little time for insights.Hevo automates data collection, freeing teams to focus on what matters: deriving actionable insights that drive exponential growth.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a product-driven, data-savvy Platform Product Owner to lead the evolution of Hevo's Data Pipelines Platform. This role blends strategic product thinking with operational excellence and offers full ownership - from defining product outcomes to driving delivery health and platform reliability.You will work closely with Engineering, Architecture, and cross-functional teams to shape the platform roadmap, define user value, and ensure successful outcomes through measurable impact. If you are passionate about building scalable, high-impact data products and excel at balancing strategy with execution - this role is for you.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Product Ownership & Strategy
Define and evolve the product vision and roadmap in collaboration with Product Leadership
Translate vision into a value-driven, structured product backlog focused on scalability, reliability, and user outcomes
Craft clear user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria and success metrics
Partner with Engineering and Architecture to design and iterate on platform capabilities aligned with long-term strategy
Analyze competitive products to identify experience gaps, technical differentiators, and new opportunities
Ensure platform capabilities deliver consistent value to internal teams and end users
Product Operations & Delivery Insights
Define and track key product health metrics (e.g., uptime, throughput, SLA adherence, adoption)
Foster a metrics-first culture in product delivery - ensuring every backlog item ties to measurable outcomes
Triage bugs and feature requests, assess impact, and feed insights into prioritization and planning
Define post-release success metrics and establish feedback loops to evaluate feature adoption and performance
Build dashboards and reporting frameworks to increase visibility into product readiness, velocity, and operations
Improve practices around backlog hygiene, estimation accuracy, and story lifecycle management
Ensure excellence in release planning and launch execution to meet quality and scalability benchmarks
Collaboration & Communication
Champion the product vision and user needs across all stages of development
Collaborate with Support, Customer Success, and Product Marketing to ensure customer insights inform product direction
Develop enablement materials (e.g., internal walkthroughs, release notes) to support go-to-market and support teams
Drive alignment and accountability throughout the product lifecycle - from planning to post-release evaluation
QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related engineering field
5–8 years of experience as a Product Manager / Product Owner, with time spent on platform/infrastructure products at B2B startups
Hands-on experience with ETL tools or modern data platforms (e.g., Talend, Informatica, AWS Glue, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks)
Strong understanding of the product lifecycle with an operations-focused mindset
Proven ability to collaborate with engineering teams to build scalable, reliable features
Familiarity with data integration, APIs, connectors, and streaming/real-time data pipelines
Analytical mindset with experience tracking KPIs and making data-informed decisions
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
Proficiency with agile product development tools (e.g., Jira, Aha!, Linear)
Experience in a data-intensive environment preferred
Engineer-turned-Product Manager with a hands-on technical background preferred
MBA from a Tier-1 institute preferred
WHY JOIN HEVO?
Work on a product used by 2,000+ companies across 40+ countries
Full ownership - from roadmap to delivery health and platform reliability
Collaborate with world-class engineers and data experts
Backed by Sequoia Capital, Chiratae, and Qualgro
Opportunity to build at the intersection of data engineering and product innovation

data.descriptionPlain:
About Hevo:

Postman, Zepto, ThoughtSpot, Whatfix, Shopify, DoorDash and thousands of other data-driven companies share one thing. They all use Hevo Data's fully managed Automated Pipelines to consolidate their data from multiple sources like Databases, Marketing Applications, Cloud Storage, SDKs, Streaming Services, etc.

We are a San Francisco/Bangalore-based company with 2000+ customers spread across 40+ countries in domains such as e-commerce, financial technology, and healthcare. Strongly backed by marquee investors like Sequoia Capital, Chiratae, and Qualgro, we have raised $43 Million to date and are looking forward to our next phase of hyper-growth!

Why do we exist?

Every company today wants to leverage cutting-edge technology - Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Predictive Analytics - to make smarter business decisions. Data is the foundational block on which these advanced techniques can be applied. However, every company's business users struggle to access accurate and reliable data. Data resides fragmented across the 100s of business software that businesses use. Most of the data operators spend time manually consolidating it, and they spend too little time deriving insights. If this ‘collection’ can be automated, it can lead to making business decisions faster, unlocking exponential growth, and delivering a superior experience to customers.

At Hevo, our mission is to enable every company to be data-driven. We started on this journey 4 years back, and as the first step in this direction, we built our first product – “Data Pipeline” or simply “Pipeline”. Hevo Pipeline is a no-code platform that helps companies connect all their data sources within the company to get a unified view of their business. The platform offers integrations with 150+ data sources, such as Databases, SaaS applications, Advertising, and Channels. Today, we enable nearly 2000 companies across more than 40+ countries to be more data-driven. We aim to make the technology so simple that anyone can solve their data problems without being limited due to their lack of technical skills.

You’ll play a strategic role in shaping operational excellence, team structure, and delivery processes to enable growth and innovation, while inspiring high performance by identifying root causes of delivery bottlenecks and empowering teams to overcome them.

lists.content:
• Build TPM Function from Scratch: Design and implement a high-performance Technical Program Management function tailored for a scaling SaaS organization.
  • Strategic Program Leadership: Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex, cross-functional programs with a focus on high impact and delivery excellence.
  • Inspire High Performance: Diagnose delivery bottlenecks, uncover root causes, and enable individuals and teams to perform at their best.
  • Ownership & Accountability: Act as a delivery owner — ensuring initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, product, design, and business stakeholders to prioritize and align on goals, deliverables, and resources.
  • Process Definition & Optimization: Define scalable workflows, tools, and rituals (Agile, Scrum, SAFe, etc.) to drive consistency and quality across the organization.
  • Tooling & Reporting: Leverage program management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, LinearB, Aha!, etc. to establish visibility, drive transparency, and enable data-driven insights.
  • Risk & Dependency Management: Anticipate risks, manage dependencies, and proactively remove blockers to keep programs on track.
  • Executive Communication: Regularly communicate program status, risks, and insights to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

• 4-10 years of experience in technical program  management in SaaS or software product companies.
  • Hands-on experience in building a program management function from scratch in an established product organization is required.
  • Strong ability to lead with high ownership, drive execution excellence, and deliver programs that move the business forward.
  • Deep understanding of Agile methodologies, SDLC, and modern software development practices.
  • Hands-on expertise with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and LinearB is required.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong technical acumen; ability to engage effectively with engineering on architecture, platforms, and technical trade-offs.
  • Experience with scaled Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe) is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field; advanced degrees or certifications are a bonus.

• Self-starter with a builder’s mindset and strong bias for action.
  • Ability to inspire and unblock teams by understanding challenges at the root level and enabling people through trust, clarity, and support.
  • Strategic and systems thinker who can also dive into execution details.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities.
  • Influential leader who earns trust and drives alignment across teams.

• High-impact leadership role in a growing SaaS organization.
  • Autonomy to design and shape the TPM function from the ground up.
  • Collaborative and inclusive team culture.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits.

Video Marketer 
About Hevo: Hevo is a simple, no-code data pipeline platform that helps companies unify and prepare their data for analytics and AI—effortlessly.
Every meaningful AI advancement starts with one critical foundation: clean, unified, and accessible data. Hevo enables 2,500+ data-driven companies—including DoorDash, Shopify, Postman, Cox Automotive, Neo4J, Arhaus, and Groww—to get their data AI-ready by automating complex integration and transformation workflows across hundreds of sources.
By removing engineering bottlenecks, Hevo allows teams to focus on what truly matters—generating insights, building intelligent products, and making faster, smarter decisions.
Role Overview: We are looking for a Video Marketer to join Hevo’s marketing team and own the end-to-end creation of high-quality video content that makes complex data engineering and B2B SaaS concepts compelling, clear, and watchable.
This is a hands-on execution role requiring strong editing skills, sharp visual storytelling instincts, and a high personal bar for quality ,from raw brief to final render.
Key Responsibilities:
Edit and produce long-form and short-form video content across formats ,product explainers, customer stories, thought leadership pieces, and social clips ,from brief to final delivery.
Translate scripts and written briefs into visually engaging video stories ,maintaining message fidelity while making confident creative decisions on pacing, transitions, motion graphics, and audio design.
Build and animate motion graphics in Adobe After Effects, managing the full post-production pipeline across Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve.
Handle audio mixing end-to-end, to deliver a polished final mix.
Collaborate with the content, design, and marketing teams to ensure all video output aligns with Hevo’s brand guidelines, visual identity, and campaign objectives.
Proactively evaluate and implement new tools across AI video, audio enhancement, b-roll generation, and storyboard design to keep Hevo’s video production at the cutting edge.
Plan and execute video shoots end-to-end ,operating Sony mirrorless cameras, setting up key and fill lighting rigs, configuring mic interfaces, and managing collar and boom mic setups to capture broadcast-quality footage.
Self-review all deliverables before submission ,catching sync issues, render artifacts, and brief deviations independently, without waiting to be flagged.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
Minimum of 1+ years of experience in Video Editing and Production.
Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (strongly preferred) or DaVinci Resolve ,must have used these tools on real projects, not just coursework.
Strong working knowledge of Adobe After Effects ,ability to build, keyframe, and animate motion graphic timelines independently.
Solid understanding of video editing fundamentals: cuts and transitions, pacing and sequencing, color correction, animation types, and visual rhythm and knowledge of audio mixing.
Visual storytelling ability: Can interpret a written brief and make confident creative decisions about how to translate copy into a compelling video narrative without distorting the message.
Strong attention to detail and a high personal quality bar ,proactively flags errors in scripts and briefs, and takes full ownership of output quality without needing to be prompted.
Curiosity about and comfort with evolving tools ,AI video, generative b-roll, open-source audio software, and automation across the production workflow.
Hands-on experience operating Sony mirrorless cameras, configuring key and fill lighting setups, and managing microphones and interfaces, comfortable directing and running a shoot independently.
Prior experience in B2B, SaaS, or tech video content is a plus; familiarity with data engineering or analytics concepts is a strong bonus.
What You’ll Gain:
Full ownership of Hevo’s video output ,a rare opportunity to shape the visual identity of a fast-growing B2B SaaS brand with real creative autonomy.
Exposure to a high-velocity content environment spanning product marketing, demand generation, and community ,across formats and audiences.
A collaborative team that values speed, quality, and craft ,you’ll be trusted to make calls and grow your skills with real projects and real impact.

Hevo enables 2,500+ data-driven companies—including DoorDash, Shopify, Postman, Cox Automotive, Neo4J, Arhaus, and Groww—to get their data AI-ready by automating complex integration and transformation workflows across hundreds of sources.

By removing engineering bottlenecks, Hevo allows teams to focus on what truly matters—generating insights, building intelligent products, and making faster, smarter decisions.

Role Overview: We are looking for a Video Marketer to join Hevo’s marketing team and own the end-to-end creation of high-quality video content that makes complex data engineering and B2B SaaS concepts compelling, clear, and watchable.

This is a hands-on execution role requiring strong editing skills, sharp visual storytelling instincts, and a high personal bar for quality ,from raw brief to final render.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Edit and produce long-form and short-form video content across formats ,product explainers, customer stories, thought leadership pieces, and social clips ,from brief to final delivery.

  • Translate scripts and written briefs into visually engaging video stories ,maintaining message fidelity while making confident creative decisions on pacing, transitions, motion graphics, and audio design.

  • Build and animate motion graphics in Adobe After Effects, managing the full post-production pipeline across Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve.

  • Handle audio mixing end-to-end, to deliver a polished final mix.

  • Collaborate with the content, design, and marketing teams to ensure all video output aligns with Hevo’s brand guidelines, visual identity, and campaign objectives.

  • Proactively evaluate and implement new tools across AI video, audio enhancement, b-roll generation, and storyboard design to keep Hevo’s video production at the cutting edge.

  • Plan and execute video shoots end-to-end ,operating Sony mirrorless cameras, setting up key and fill lighting rigs, configuring mic interfaces, and managing collar and boom mic setups to capture broadcast-quality footage.

  • Self-review all deliverables before submission ,catching sync issues, render artifacts, and brief deviations independently, without waiting to be flagged.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 1+ years of experience in Video Editing and Production.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (strongly preferred) or DaVinci Resolve ,must have used these tools on real projects, not just coursework.

  • Strong working knowledge of Adobe After Effects ,ability to build, keyframe, and animate motion graphic timelines independently.

  • Solid understanding of video editing fundamentals: cuts and transitions, pacing and sequencing, color correction, animation types, and visual rhythm and knowledge of audio mixing.

  • Visual storytelling ability: Can interpret a written brief and make confident creative decisions about how to translate copy into a compelling video narrative without distorting the message.

  • Strong attention to detail and a high personal quality bar ,proactively flags errors in scripts and briefs, and takes full ownership of output quality without needing to be prompted.

  • Curiosity about and comfort with evolving tools ,AI video, generative b-roll, open-source audio software, and automation across the production workflow.

  • Hands-on experience operating Sony mirrorless cameras, configuring key and fill lighting setups, and managing microphones and interfaces, comfortable directing and running a shoot independently.

  • Prior experience in B2B, SaaS, or tech video content is a plus; familiarity with data engineering or analytics concepts is a strong bonus.

What You’ll Gain:

  • Full ownership of Hevo’s video output ,a rare opportunity to shape the visual identity of a fast-growing B2B SaaS brand with real creative autonomy.

  • Exposure to a high-velocity content environment spanning product marketing, demand generation, and community ,across formats and audiences.

  • A collaborative team that values speed, quality, and craft ,you’ll be trusted to make calls and grow your skills with real projects and real impact.

data.descriptionPlain:
Hevo (www.hevodata.com) is a simple, intuitive, and powerful No-code Data Pipeline platform that enables companies to consolidate data from multiple software for faster analytics.

Hevo powers data analytics for 2000+ data-driven companies across multiple industry verticals including Shopify, DoorDash, Deliverr, Neo4J, Arhaus, Marqeta, and Postman. By automating complex data integration tasks, Hevo allows data teams to focus on deriving groundbreaking insights and driving their businesses forward.

Hevo’s mission is simple, but bold: Build technology that is simple to adopt and easy to access so that everyone can unlock the potential of data.

Headquartered in San Francisco and with offices in India, Hevo has seen exponential growth since its inception. Hevo’s revenue and customer base has expanded by a staggering 3X in just the last two years.

With total funding of $42 Mil (Series B) from Sequoia India, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, Hevo is now entering a new phase of hyper-growth.

Hevoites are a bunch of thoughtful, helpful problem solvers, who are obsessed with making a difference in the lives of their customers, colleagues, and their own individual trajectory.

If you are passionate about redefining the future of technology, then Hevo is the place for you.

Product Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p0XGLDgvCo8

What you’ll own as a Product Marketing Leader:

lists.text: A - Own the positioning and messaging of our products, to increase pipeline and adoption
lists.content:
• Conduct primary and secondary research to discover user and buyer personas, their pains and expected gains, and the competitor landscape to refine positioning
  • Build a deep understanding of our product, use cases and competitive landscape (direct and indirect) to develop an SSOT of value-prop and external messaging that resonates with the intended audience

lists.text: B - Help Sales and Sales Enablement teams to improve the sales outcome
lists.content:
• Conduct quantitative and qualitative win/loss and competition analysis to drive effective objection handling and consistency in our sales conversations
  • Collaborate with functional leads to turn intel into effective collaterals - pitch decks, demos, case studies, and the like, and own its adoption to improve win rates and lower sales cycles

lists.text: C - Drive customer advocacy to improve adoption, usage and referrals
lists.content:
• Collaborate with product and customer success teams to drive the adoption and usage of features
  • Develop and nurture customers into advocates across a spectrum ranging from external reviews, beta-testing groups, customer advisory board, and external evangelists

lists.text: D - Build and execute GTM strategies for new and existing products
lists.content:
• Build a deep understanding of our product, competition, and the larger ecosystem to play an active role in pricing and packaging decisions
  • Own the GTM for new features by collaborating with product and sales teams to establish the plan and orchestrate marketing execution to achieve those goals
  • Collaborate with the Sales and Product team to do 0-1 market discovery and development for new products

lists.text: E - Build and grow the Product Marketing team
lists.content:
• Hiring: Plan and hire for headcount to keep up with the scope of PMM responsibilities
  • Mentor and coach team members to improve overall team performance and ensure continuous learning and career growth

lists.text: F - Improve Hevo’s position and equity in the market
lists.content:
• Collaborate with industry analysts, experts, and influencers to create and maintain relevance, brand awareness, and visibility for Hevo
  • Develop thought leadership to position Hevo as one of the key stakeholders in the Modern Data Stack space

lists.text: What you’ll bring to the table:
lists.content:
• 10+ years of experience in Product Marketing. Experience in building processes about user research messaging, persona research, and GTM strategy for scaling product marketing
  • Preference: Worked at an infrastructure product company/dev tools company marketing to developers and created an impact
  • Preference: Should have experience in doing Product Marketing at companies with Mid Market and Enterprise customers
  • Excellent communication skills - verbal and written
  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills for cross-functional collaboration
  • Ability to empathetically understand and solve customer issues
  • Deep understanding of the business and the market trends
  • Experience in driving business impact at a growth-stage startup in a senior or leadership role
